orders.A: (s_R(o), [m != m_R(o)], completion, m, j), smallest first
orders.B: ([m != m_R(o)], s_R(o), completion, m, j), smallest first
orders.C: (c_R(o), [m != m_R(o)], completion, m, j), smallest first

departure: the chosen pair (o, m) is off the reference when m != m_R(o) or an operation that R places on m_R(o) before o is not yet dispatched
class_test: R in the class: in the order of R's processing starts, every operation starts at its earliest start on its reference machine given R's earlier operations, and no candidate pair starts earlier
gap: 100 (x - reference) / reference per case; negative means x is shorter
bootstrap: stats_family.instance_boot, 20000 resamples, fresh default_rng(7); pooled, a drawn instance brings all its combinations
shares: at or below: replay <= reference; within 1%: gap <= 1; above 5%: gap > 5
left: mean over cases of 100 x (decisions of order A off the reference) / decisions
buildable: % of references in the class (equal to the % that order A reproduces exactly)
outside: mean over cases of the % of the operations of a reference that fail the class test: in total, because the operation starts later than its earliest start on its machine, and because another pair could start earlier
rule: per-instance best of FIFO, MOR, SPT and MWKR restricted to the legal pairs (stored exact-mask arrays)
bound: per case the shorter of the replay and the best classical rule; both schedules are built under the mask, so its gap to the reference is also an upper bound on what the mask costs
